name: Serug
overview: Serug, also known as Saruch, is a key ancestor in the genealogical line leading to Abraham, as documented in Genesis and Luke. Scripture records that Serug was born to Reu when Reu was thirty-two years old and later fathered Nahor. His lifespan extended over two hundred years, during which he had other sons and daughters. The chronicled lineage in 1 Chronicles and Luke highlights Serug's role in God's providential plan to bring forth the covenant family through Abraham.
